prompt: On what day, month, and year did President Gustavo Petro receive the President of Switzerland, Alain Berset, at the Casa de Nariño, where they signed an agreement to safeguard the fund, a digital copy of the documentary collection of the Commission for the Clarification of the Truth, in Switzerland?
answer: President Gustavo Petro received Swiss President Alain Berset at the Casa de Nariño on **10 August 2023**.
